title: Qualify JDK range fill and the independently checked caller frame
description: Rebuild the JDK 21 and example 337 evidence and run the Rust checker from isolated inputs on the real range fill, ordinary observing caller, extra-write caller, and five rebound controls. Check per-edge omissions and callee substitutions, compare physical JVM outcomes on shared and independently sized roots, measure clean generation and replay, and recheck all 18 Guava transfer bundles and substitutions.
expected: Original fill and caller accepted, two checked caller witnesses, no false acceptance, 14 range and binding controls as expected and all 18 Guava controls reproduced.

steps.name: Rebuild bundles and qualify the write frame
